prompt: Bug report from a user: "`trailhead summary` shows `time 0h 44m` for a flat 3.74 km walk. By Naismith's rule that is 44.9 minutes, and the README says times are rounded to the nearest minute." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git ls-files; cat README* | head -50; grep -rn "int(\|round\|//\|floor" --include=*.py . | grep -v test | head -30
sed -n 50,90p README.md; cat src/trailhead/report.py src/trailhead/plan.py src/trailhead/pace.py; grep -n "0h\|h \|m\b" tests/test_report.py tests/test_plan.py tests/test_cli.py | head -30

cd src/trailhead && python - <<'EOF'
import re
p=open('pace.py').read()
p=p.replace('''def tobler_kmh''','''def format_duration(hours: float) -> str:
    """Format hours as ``<hours>h <minutes>m``, rounded to the nearest minute.

    Halves round up, so 44.5 minutes is ``0h 45m``.
    """
    whole, minutes = divmod(floor(hours * 60 + 0.5), 60)
    return f"{whole}h {minutes:02d}m"


def tobler_kmh''',1).replace('from math import exp','from math import exp, floor')
open('pace.py','w').write(p)
r=open('report.py').read()
r=r.replace('from trailhead.pace import naismith_hours','from trailhead.pace import format_duration, naismith_hours')
r=r.replace('    whole, minutes = divmod(int(summary.hours * 60), 60)\n','')
r=r.replace('{whole}h {minutes:02d}m','{format_duration(summary.hours)}')
open('report.py','w').write(r)
q=open('plan.py').read()
q=q.replace('from trailhead.pace import leg_hours','from trailhead.pace import format_duration, leg_hours')
q=q.replace('        whole, minutes = divmod(int(hours * 60), 60)\n','')
q=q.replace('{whole}h {minutes:02d}m','{format_duration(hours)}')
open('plan.py','w').write(q)
EOF
cd ../.. && git diff --stat && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15
head -15 tests/test_pace.py; cat tests/test_report.py | head -30; grep -n "def \|Track(\|Point(" tests/conftest.py tests/test_plan.py | head

sed -i 's/^from trailhead.pace import leg_hours, naismith_hours, tobler_kmh/from trailhead.pace import format_duration, leg_hours, naismith_hours, tobler_kmh/' tests/test_pace.py
cat >> tests/test_pace.py <<'EOF'


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("hours", "text"),
    [
        (naismith_hours(3.74, 0), "0h 45m"),  # 44.88 minutes: rounds up, not down
        (44.4 / 60, "0h 44m"),
        (44.5 / 60, "0h 45m"),
        (59.7 / 60, "1h 00m"),
        (5 + 7 / 60, "5h 07m"),
        (12.0, "12h 00m"),
        (0.0, "0h 00m"),
    ],
)
def test_format_duration_rounds_to_nearest_minute(hours, text):
    assert format_duration(hours) == text
EOF
cat >> tests/test_plan.py <<'EOF'


def test_describe_plan_rounds_to_nearest_minute():
    assert describe_plan([(1, 0, 3, 0.748)]) == ["Day 1: points 0-3, 0h 45m"]
EOF
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; ruff check; mypy 2>&1 | tail -1
